_about: Per-tab model order. The router tries each model in order (only models installed on the server), then the default and free fallbacks. Ranked for speed first on this CPU-only server; 'with_gpu' is the upgrade order once the server has a graphics card. Normal (not uncensored) open models only.

facts.why: Qwen 2.5 scores highest of the small models on knowledge and reasoning tests; 7B when you want more depth.

code.why: Qwen 2.5 Coder is trained for code and beats general models of the same size.

creative.why: Llama 3.2 writes livelier, more natural prose; Qwen 7B for long structured scripts.
